commentary.text: 90+11' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Matthis Abline (Nantes) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+7' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
90+6' Remy Cabella (Nantes) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+6' Nantes are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
90+4' It will be a substitution. Khalis Merah (Lyon) is ready to enter the pitch as Pavel Sulc walks off.
90+2' POST! Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
89' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.

88' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and low towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Dominik Greif and his nice save.
88' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mohamed Kaba as he is replaced by Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes).
86' Afonso Moreira is substituted due to injury. Paulo Fonseca gives a chance to Hans Hateboer (Lyon).
84' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nantes.
82' Mohamed Kaba (Nantes) gets booked for the first time in this match.
82' Nantes are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

71' It is time for a substitution. Abakar Sylla (Nantes) is on for Nicolas Cozza.
71' Ahmed Kantari has decided to substitute Kelvin Amian and he is replaced by Francis Coquelin (Nantes).

69' Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Dominik Greif shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
68' The Nantes players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
66' Ali Youssef (Nantes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mathieu Vernice had an easy-decision to make.
65' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:10.
63' Problems for Ahmed Kantari as Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Deiver Machado replaces him.
61' Endrick (Lyon) is sent off by the referee after receiving a harsh red card!
61' Referee Mathieu Vernice is going to consult VAR for a possible red card infringement after that scuffle between the two teams, as it’s not immediately clear who the culprit was.
57' Matthis Abline (Nantes) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mathieu Vernice no option but to blow his whistle.
56' Endrick (Lyon) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

54' Nice passing game by Nantes. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
51' Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the left post with a fine header. What a chance!

49' Nantes are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.

45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

44' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
44' Neat passing move from Lyon in order to create new attacking opportunities.
42' A player from Lyon commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
40' Nantes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
38' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kelvin Amian (Nantes) was quite harsh and Mathieu Vernice didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) commits a rough challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.

34' Ali Youssef (Nantes) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
33' Good work from Nantes as they win a corner.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nantes.
32' Fabien Centonze (Nantes) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

28' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Afonso Moreira (Lyon).

26' Mathieu Vernice sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
26' The Lyon players halt their celebrations as referee Mathieu Vernice makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
25' 0 - 1 Pavel Sulc (Lyon) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the right side of the goal.
24' Lyon force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
24' The ball possession at the moment is 38:62.
22' Noah Nartey (Lyon) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
20' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

20' Anthony Lopes doesn't have to worry about this one. Endrick plays a pass into the feet of Tanner Tessmann (Lyon), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the left post.
19' A fine pass finds Afonso Moreira (Lyon) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Anthony Lopes reacts superbly to deny him.
17' Great teamplay by Lyon as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
15' Endrick (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
13' Nantes hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
10' The ball is out of play. Nantes win a corner kick.
10' Matthis Abline (Nantes) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well over the bar.
9' The Lyon players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

7' Mohamed Kaba (Nantes) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the left post. Nice run, but unlucky finish! The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lyon.
